name: Jehoiakim
summary: A son of King Josiah whom the king of Egypt set on the throne of Judah, changing his name from Eliakim. He did evil in the LORD's eyes and burned the scroll of the LORD's words that had been written down as Jeremiah spoke them.

key_moments.title: Made King by Pharaoh
key_moments.description: Pharaohnechoh made Eliakim son of Josiah king and changed his name to Jehoiakim. Jehoiakim taxed the people of the land to pay the silver and gold Pharaoh demanded, and he did evil in the LORD's eyes.

key_moments.title: Rebelling Against Babylon
key_moments.description: When Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came, Jehoiakim served him for three years, then turned against him. The LORD sent bands of raiders against Judah, as His prophets had said.

key_moments.title: Has the Prophet Urijah Killed
key_moments.description: When the prophet Urijah spoke against the city as Jeremiah did, Jehoiakim tried to kill him. Urijah fled to Egypt, but the king had him brought back and put him to death by the sword.

key_moments.title: Burns Jeremiah's Scroll
key_moments.description: As Jehudi read Jeremiah's scroll to the king by the fire, a few leaves at a time were cut off and thrown into the flames until the king had burned it all. The LORD said none of Jehoiakim's line would sit on David's throne.
